mapper.insert: insert into ip_invocation_log(trace_id, route_type, interface_code, interface_name, caller, target_system, request_method, request_path, target_address, call_status, platform_code, http_status, duration_ms, request_headers, request_summary, response_headers, response_summary, error_message, call_time, completed_at) values (#{value.traceId}, #{value.routeType}, #{value.interfaceCode}, #{value.interfaceName}, #{value.caller}, #{value.targetSystem}, #{value.requestMethod}, #{value.requestPath}, #{value.targetAddress}, #{value.callStatus}, #{value.platformCode}, #{value.httpStatus}, #{value.durationMs}, #{value.requestHeaders}, #{value.requestSummary}, #{value.responseHeaders}, #{value.responseSummary}, #{value.errorMessage}, #{value.callTime}, #{value.completedAt})
mapper.select: select trace_id, route_type, interface_code, interface_name, caller, target_system, request_method, request_path, call_status, platform_code, http_status, duration_ms, call_time from ip_invocation_log order by call_time desc limit #{limit}
